blocks.heading: About Here & Now
blocks.body: Here & Now Productions is a London theatre company run by Joseph Winters and Emma Halstead, making theatre and performance where the relationship between actor and audience is the most important thing — often in spaces that weren't built to be theatres at all. Current work includes The Bulletin, a monthly scratch night at The Old Red Lion, Islington, and V is for Victims, a new musical comedy for 2027.
